mainEntity.name: How does the interview copilot answer in real time?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fully on-device Vosk recognizer transcribes the interviewer as they speak. The moment they stop, your résumé and the company Q&A database are retrieved and fed to the model, and a tight, speakable answer streams into the overlay in about a second. No clip uploads and no round-trip latency.

mainEntity.name: Can the interviewer see the copilot on screen share?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. On Windows the overlay uses SetWindowDisplayAffinity with WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE, so it renders on your monitor but is composited out of the frame Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Discord, OBS, and PrintScreen capture. It also stays out of the taskbar and Alt-Tab, and a live shield badge shows the current protection state.

mainEntity.name: What are the interview questions grounded in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every live answer is retrieved from your résumé plus a company-specific Q&A database of behavioral, fundamentals, and coding questions with model answers in your voice. You build that database in seconds with the Company Q&A Generator on this page.

mainEntity.name: Which AI models does the interview copilot use?

acceptedAnswer.text: It queries Grok, DeepSeek, and Gemini, and can also run against a local model for a fully offline path. You choose which models to use, and only the models you pick are called.
M pauses the copilot instantly so it stops listening and answering, and P toggles ghost mode to dim the overlay. Both are global hotkeys, so you never touch the window during the call.
